"Obtained from untrusted sources are stored outside the web root and limited permissions." -> "Untrusted file data obtained from untrusted sources are stored outside the web root and limited permissions"

16.3 Adding the need for AV I think is excessive as using a mime-aware library such as Apache Tika should largely remove the need for AV unless you allow users to upload dangerous file types such as EXEs

There is no mention of the following controls:

- size limits
- # limits
- quota limits per user (if needed)
- possibly using a different sub-domain to serve user uploads to prevent XSS
- the uploading of in-intentionally uploading executable code such as SVG images which are then served directly back to users
